record: THE DISABLED PRODUCTION RELEASE, AND WHAT THE SERVING PROCESS ANSWERED
what_this_is: Every figure here came back from the process serving https://sportsassets-api.onrender.com,
read from a GitHub runner because this container has no egress to that host (403 at the
proxy). Nothing here was read from a test interpreter, and nothing here submitted an order.

boot_log: migrate failed — serving anyway; will apply on next boot
cause: production is PostgreSQL 18.6; every database the file had met (local, and every gate
checkout) is 16.13. PostgreSQL 17 and later run maintenance work -- an index BUILD
included -- under a safe search_path of 'pg_catalog, pg_temp', and a SQL function body is
re-parsed when the planner inlines it. The two partial indexes in 126 have a predicate
whose body called two other funded functions unqualified, so those names could not be
resolved at build time and the whole file rolled back.

reproduced_on_16.how: SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp, then evaluate the predicate
reproduced_on_16.unqualified_body: ERROR: function f_out(text) does not exist / CONTEXT: SQL function "f_open" during inlining

the_defect_the_first_readback_found.fix: 714680b -- every funded SQL function body schema-qualifies the funded functions and tables it names
what_it_says_about_the_gate: a suite whose database is two major versions behind production cannot see a
version-dependent failure. The gate on 07c67f3 was green by identity and the schema still
did not apply. The two tests move the check into a form 16 can evaluate; they do not make
the gate a substitute for the production boot log.
what_it_says_about_the_panel: it reported the failure instead of rendering an empty book. A funded section that had shown
'0 positions, $0.00' over an unmigrated schema would have been the serious outcome.

funded_functions_in_production: bettor_funded_holds_inventory(residual numeric, closed timestamptz) -> boolean, IMMUTABLE
bettor_funded_position_is_open(s text, residual numeric, closed timestamptz) -> boolean, IMMUTABLE

what_this_establishes: the scheduled engine reached evaluation on current markets and declined on named grounds.
It is not 'nothing happened': thirteen distinct refusal counters fired, one candidate was
evaluated and one valuation was written. It is also not a qualifying candidate.
one_completed_scheduled_cycle.what_it_does_not_establish: any funded activity. No funded account is bound, so servicing returns not-configured.

the_funded_servicing_precondition.read_twice_and_agreeing: the admin readiness endpoint and the command centre's own activation panel report the same eight
why_the_heartbeat_does_not_carry_the_ser: cycle() runs _funded_service first, ahead of the entry lane's stop, table and credential
gates, but _heartbeat persists the ENTRY lane's tally only. The precondition is therefore
read directly rather than inferred from a row that does not contain it.

the_demonstration_is_separate_and_labell.label: CONTROLLED DEMONSTRATION — SOFTWARE PROOF, NOT PERFORMANCE

why_its_own_job: the acceptance suite is twenty-six steps and most of an hour, and it spends the odds and
venue budgets. A release readback has to be legible on its own and must not inherit a pass
from a step nineteen places away, so a funded_readback dispatch skips that job entirely.
the_readback_instrument.expect_commit: fails the job on any build other than the named SHA, so a readback cannot be attributed to a deploy that did not land
two_defects_in_the_instrument_itself_fou: it called every non-200 on the desk read 'the command role was not accepted' -- an
authorization answer where the truth was a 502 four seconds after a deploy went live. 401
and 403 now fail at once; 5xx and a dead connection retry.
'|| echo 000' concatenated a second 000 onto curl's own timeout status and printed HTTP
000000, a status that does not exist.

what_this_record_does_not_claim: that the funded lane has traded. It has not, and no funded account is bound.
that a qualifying candidate exists. One valuation was written; nothing was admitted.
that the gate establishes production behaviour. It runs on PostgreSQL 16.13 and production is 18.6.
that any of this is authorization to trade.
